name: observability
description: Wraps core/observability.py's self-status introspection (token usage, memory status, task queue depth, active model, temperature/context size, process CPU/memory usage, daemon uptime/PID, rolled-up health) as CCOS capabilities. Distinct from thermal_monitor's system-wide CPU/RAM/temp snapshot — this plugin's cpu_usage/memory_usage report this process's own resource use.

capabilities.name: system.observability_tokens_used
capabilities.description: Total tokens used so far, from the shared state store

capabilities.name: system.observability_memory_loaded
capabilities.description: Five-tier memory system's status dict (or an error dict if uninitialized)

capabilities.name: system.observability_tasks_pending
capabilities.description: Number of pending tasks in the task queue/planner

capabilities.name: system.observability_model_active
capabilities.description: Name of the currently loaded/active model, or None

capabilities.name: system.observability_model_state
capabilities.description: Model state dict from the shared state store

capabilities.name: system.observability_memory_usage
capabilities.description: This process's own RSS/VMS memory usage in MB (not the system-wide RAM covered by thermal_monitor)

capabilities.name: system.observability_cpu_usage
capabilities.description: This process's own CPU usage percentage (not the system-wide CPU covered by thermal_monitor)

capabilities.name: system.observability_uptime
capabilities.description: Daemon uptime in seconds, or 0 if no daemon start time is recorded

capabilities.name: system.observability_daemon_pid
capabilities.description: PID of this process, or None if psutil isn't available

capabilities.name: system.observability_health
capabilities.description: Rolled-up health summary: memory usage, CPU usage, uptime, pending tasks, model-loaded flag

capabilities.name: system.observability_full_status
capabilities.description: Complete observability status: version, daemon, model, tasks, memory, cpu, tokens, health. Backs get_full_status()/to_dict()/status(), which are all identical.

capabilities.name: system.observability_reset_state
capabilities.description: Drop the process-wide State singleton so the next call rebuilds it. Minor mutation, low risk: nothing currently depends on this state.

author: CCOS
